objects.name: Analytic 1653
objects.description: For Android, detect Compromise Hardware Supply Chain by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; Network Traffic Content via Enterprise Secure Web Gateway / Proxy [DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Correlation window between enrollment/posture anomaly, privileged capability use, and network egress.
Approved system identities, preload packages, and OEM services differ by model and fleet.
OEM update, activation, MDM, and enterprise service destinations vary by environment.
Some protected resource access may be legitimate only when the app is foregrounded.
Defines how close resource access must be to user interaction to be considered expected.
Initial setup/update behavior may generate benign network or configuration drift for a short period.
Size threshold for suspicious outbound transfer from a device in abnormal posture.
Known-good build fingerprint, patch, boot state, and baseband combinations vary by device fleet.
